answer_4.quote: We conduct a human study to assess the plausibility of the generated descriptions, finding that GPT-4o correctly identifies the presence or absence of a pattern in 80% of the cases.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators evaluated the responses in terms of (a) whether GPT-4o correctly recognized the existence of a pattern, (b) the quality of the generated descriptions, and (c) the category of the recognized patterns.
